method: Complete reads of seven pinned configuration/source files; Git/SHA256 verification. Executed original AST-extracted version writer and fallback reader against a temporary generated file, without setup invocation or installation.
findings: Version writer emits __version__, __pep440__, __revision__, but fallback reader requests version and pep440. Original writer/reader control returns None for its own generated file. Thus fallback-only packaging cannot determine version via this path; full wheel/sdist failure not executed.

Build hook compiles GResource into source tree and asks glib tool for dependencies, splitting whitespace. Package requires Python>=3.12 with GTK/PyGObject/Cairo and includes only compiled resource bundle as package data. Installed schema/desktop integration depends on separate build/install system.

Desktop TryExec checks shredder while Exec invokes rmlint --gui; availability checks and executed command differ. Manual Makefile uses in-memory settings and local schema/locale paths, so development run does not qualify installed persistent configuration.

Schema defaults: BLAKE2b, report hardlinks, see symlinks, partial-hidden directory use, cross mounts, no name restriction, min1/maxUINT64 bytes and max-depth512. Handler defaults removal. These defaults intentionally differ from exhaustive exact-file equality over all entries.

Algorithm enum lists native CRC choices without per-machine capability gating in schema; launcher selection ultimately relies on scanner validation. Size limits tuple has no relational minimum<=maximum constraint in schema.

TODO explicitly calls out discoverability of size/mtime search and incomplete translation marking. Ignore rules exclude generated resource/version/schema artifacts; their presence cannot be inferred from tracked source.
limits: No package install, schema runtime or GUI rendering.
